digest.component_or_area: plan review gate calibration (E3 measurement framework)
propositions: Deterministic measurement infrastructure (stratified sample, frozen baseline, metrics library, replay driver seams, golden tests) was designed and built as WIP on branch calib/6982-e3 and intentionally not landed on main.
The expensive ~450-run live LLM batch replay (coarse ~200-ticket sweep plus precise 50-ticket x3 candidate and x3 current fresh runs) is permanently rejected on cost grounds.

The verdict-perturbation signal that the batch replay would have measured is now accumulated at zero marginal LLM cost by the standing criterion_effectiveness.py recorder in story d8a5 (change #798, merged).
History-based mining of baselines is infeasible: only ~4 plan-v3 sidecar baselines exist versus ~200 needed due to impact_model_version version bump stranding the historical data.

The replay driver removes two confounds: recall contamination via prior_concerns and baseline drift plus LLM nondeterminism, using recall-stripped clone (copy store, delete REVIEW_RESULT.json files) and two-tier fresh replay of both candidate and current gate.

The false-positive control criterion requires that on 30 sampled historical passing plans, either new blocking findings count ≤3 or median new advisory count rises by ≤1 per review, with production PASS→BLOCK flip rate ≤2% on the wider cleanly-closed sample.
